C_bypass_paths.action: Open /assessment, click 'Next step' five times, click Submit.
C_bypass_paths.why_it_works: useForm defaultValues are a complete synthetic Canadian farm ('Sarah Thompson', 'Thompson Prairie Farm', 520 ha, Wheat 300 ha / Canola 220 ha, fertilisers, pesticides, tractor, grid electricity, market 18 km; page.tsx:117-337). Every step therefore passes trigger() (page.tsx:410-453) and handleSubmit's full-schema resolver (page.tsx:116, 691) without the user entering anything.
C_bypass_paths.server_result: POST /assess/stream accepts (country 'Global', region 'CA'); a complete demo assessment is persisted under the user's account and shown as a real result. Mitigation that exists: none (the stepper is not clickable, page.tsx:786-840, so step skipping is blocked, but demo prefill makes that moot).

C_bypass_paths.action: Fill valid values, reach Review, click Previous, delete e.g. annualProduction, return to Review, Submit.
C_bypass_paths.server_result: Blocked: 'Next step' re-runs trigger() for that step (page.tsx:419) and Submit runs handleSubmit(onSubmit) which re-validates the whole zod schema (page.tsx:691; ReviewSubmitStep.tsx:389-393). The only UI-side gaps are values zod allows: fertiliser/pesticide rows with applicationRate 0 or applicationsPerSeason 0 (defaults when a row is added: ManagementPracticesStep.tsx:317-325, PestManagementStep.tsx:230-239), equipment with hoursPerYear 0 (EquipmentEnergyStep.tsx:124), energy/fuel rows with monthlyConsumption 0 (295, 433), usesFertilizers true with zero rows. These are sent and the engine silently ignores them (inputs.py:240-241, 262-263, 278-280, 318-319; pesticides.py:119-122), so a 'fertilised, sprayed, mechanised' farm can be submitted with zero inputs and no warning.

seasonal_factor is always 'WetSeason' (CropDetailsStep.tsx:137; no input for seasonality.season; api.ts:603 takes season[0]). The engine uses it to pick the irrigation share for the water estimate (crop_defaults.py:153) when irrigation_water_m3 is blank. The user cannot influence this.

C_bypass_paths.action: Enter packaging material, distance to market, transport mode, input transport km in the Equipment step.
C_bypass_paths.server_result: Pydantic accepts `logistics` (models.py:308) but routes.py:72-89 never forwards it to the engine. The user's logistics are silently discarded; the engine applies a 230 km default for input transport (inputs.py:97, 433-436) and no packaging/market transport. Confirmed by grep: no code path adds request.logistics to rust_input.
